title: Workflows End to End: Typed Ports, Real Schema Flow, Config on Node
description: Master program absorbing "Configured Node Apps" (.cursor/plans/configured_node_apps_30251998.plan.md) and "Workflows use pack/dsl" (ticket 26/07/30/WORKFLOWS-USE-PACK-DSL-DOCUMENTS-AND-PROTOCOL-OP-COMMANDS). Makes workflows the real integration layer: one canonical MediaPortSpec port model populated by all ~52 apps, one kernel Workflow document (node absorbs app-instance), per-node Config artifact for UI state, typed edge negotiation replacing string-equality checks, a live scheduler + headless SpaceRunner executing real data flow (flagship: block3d's object-kind catalog -> puzzle3d kit input). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/workflows-are-still-adhoc-zany-pearl.md. Executed wave by wave (0-6) via parallel sub-agents, file-disjoint packages per wave.
summary:
Wave-2 fan-out slice: applied the Config recipe (pure DocumentApp/Config/ConfigOperation/Command B1 migration) and Port recipe (typed workflow ports + export_media/import_media) to the lowpoly and process3d apps.

lowpoly: LowpolyPlayRuntime's RefCell state (selection, active object, paint utility/layer, selection method/mode, hover, world camera, sun, show-edges) plus the old ViewState-sourced active_utility_id/locale absorbed into lowpoly_engine::LowpolyConfig (flattened scalar fields; nested types like LowpolySelection/WorldSunConfig aren't dsl::DslField-capable so were flattened rather than embedded). LowpolyConfigOperation added in lowpoly_op (one variant per interaction + Snapshot, backwards always returns Snapshot). LowpolyCommand added in lowpoly_protocol covering every declared action (~50 variants). LowpolyPlayApp::handle rewritten from the old handle_action/ActionEmit/NoConfig API to pure handle/Emit/LowpolyConfig; the 7 genuine mid-gesture RefCells (stroke/transform sessions, texture cache, preview_seq) were kept per the trait's scratch+commit pattern. New ports: mesh:in (In, Many, unrequired) and mesh:out (Out, Many, unrequired, kind_id "3d.mesh") declared via lowpoly_engine::lowpoly_io(); export_media/import_media reuse the pre-existing lowpoly_mesh_from_document/mesh_document_from_mesh/mesh_from_mesh_document/lowpoly_document_from_mesh helpers and the existing LowpolyOperation::SetProjection variant. The private 3d.mesh ArtifactKindSpec declaration in create_lowpoly_app was left untouched (MediaType{ThreeD,Mesh}, schema "mesh.reference") — confirmed still the canonical shape other parallel plugins may also declare.

process3d: Process3dRuntime (selected_id/hovered_id/selected_face_id/selection_method/engagement_input/camera/sun) plus active_utility_id/locale absorbed into process_3d_engine::Process3dConfig (camera/sun flattened to scalars). Process3dConfigOperation added in process_3d_op. Process3dCommand added in process_3d_protocol covering all ~25 actions. Process3dPlayApp is now a plain unit struct (no RefCells needed, no mid-drag scratch in this app) implementing pure handle/Emit. New ports: geometry:in (In, ThreeD×Any, Many) and brep:out (Out, ThreeD×Brep, Many, kind_id "3d.process") via process_3d_engine::process3d_io(); export_media("brep:out") reuses export_process3d_model(fixture,"step"); import_media("geometry:in") is a best-effort STEP-text importer via import_process3d_model pending the upstream cad/lowpoly wire contract (flagged as a judgment call, not a hard blocker). The existing 3d.process ArtifactKindSpec was left untouched and reused verbatim as brep:out's kind_id.

Verification: cargo check --all-targets and cargo test --lib green across all 20 lowpoly+process3d packages (221 tests passing). One pre-existing, confirmed non-migration-caused flaky test found in process3d's engine crate (tests::attach_increases_volume_above_stock — a shared-static kernel-memo test-isolation bug, unrelated code, byte-identical before/after this work) — flagged as a separate follow-up task (task_aa31129d), not fixed here (out of scope: lives in shared kernel/test-isolation territory, not the Config/port recipe).

Files touched: lowpoly's ⚙️engine/🔧️op/📡️protocol/🖱️ui crates (🗣️dsl/🎒️pack/🛂️manifest untouched — no changes needed); process3d's ⚙️engine/🔧️op/📡️protocol/🖱️ui crates (🗣️dsl/🎒️pack/🛂️manifest untouched).
